profile.name: FieldFox 手持式矢量网络分析仪
profile.description: FieldFox 是一类便携式射频/微波矢量网络分析仪，用于对器件和网络进行扫频测量并获取 S 参数响应。它常用于实验室和现场测试中的滤波器、放大器、传输线及其他射频微波部件表征。
profile.description_en: FieldFox is a portable RF/microwave vector network analyzer used to sweep frequency and measure S-parameter responses of devices and networks. It is commonly used in laboratories and field testing to characterize filters, amplifiers, transmission lines, and other RF/microwave components.
